name: HyperWrite
tagline: AI writing assistant with autocomplete, web research, and citations.
description: HyperWrite is an AI writing assistant that drafts, rewrites, and autocompletes text across the web, with research and inline citations. It runs as a web app and a Chrome extension, and adds a personal-assistant agent that can carry out multi-step browser tasks. It is built by OthersideAI, one of the first companies to ship a consumer product on GPT-3.
insight: Built by OthersideAI, founded July 2020 — among the earliest commercial products built on OpenAI's GPT-3, with roughly 2M users.

modelSupport.notes: Models abstracted from the user; has run on OpenAI and Cohere models over its history.

edge: Pairs a writing assistant with a browser agent that runs multi-step web tasks, going beyond drafting into doing the follow-up work.
pros: Autocomplete and rewrite across any site
cons: Output quality trails frontier chat assistants
